description.description: The description of the parameter. It is included in the response if the user has read-only permissions to the Synthetics app.

id.description: The unique identifier of the parameter.

namespaces.description: The namespaces associated with the parameter. It is included in the response if the user has read-only permissions to the Synthetics app.

tags.description: An array of tags associated with the parameter. It is included in the response if the user has read-only permissions to the Synthetics app.

value.description: The value associated with the parameter. It will be included in the response if the user has write permissions.
